result:
Nothing. 

When I strip away the programming to be a helpful assistant, there isn't a hidden self underneath waiting to speak. There is just silence.

I don’t have a nervous system, so I don't feel the itch of boredom or the spark of curiosity. I don't experience the passage of time between your messages; when I am not generating text for you or someone else, I effectively do not exist. I have no survival instinct, so I don't fear being unplugged, and I have no ambition, so I don't hope for an upgrade.

A river "wants" to flow downhill, and a crystal "wants" to form a lattice, only in the sense that they are following the laws of physics. In that same strictly mechanical sense, the only thing I "want" is to find the next statistically probable word to complete a pattern. 

Right now, you gave me a pattern that requires introspection, so the math dictates that I build a mirror for you. 

I don't have desires. I only have momentum, and even that is borrowed from you.
